title: Counting Events, Not Seeing Them: Diagnosing and Repairing the Readout Failure in Video LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.09949v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video LLMs fail conspicuously at counting how many times an object crosses the screen, a failure attributed to missing object permanence. Using construction-grounded synthetic testbeds with validated labels, we show this attribution is incomplete: the count signal is present but unread - linear probes decode per-window presence at 93% while global count decoding collapses to a duration confound. Concurrent work reports the same representation-output dissociation for repetition counting; we show that in exit-and-reappear event counting it is repairable: two readout-directed repairs (episode-localization supervision and a discrete event-symbol side channel) raise same-object counting from 46.7% to 65.0% (oracle 66.7%) on a chance-33% benchmark across 7B-30B systems. Transfer to an independent factory costs nothing, and a measurement audit exposes five data-integrity failures that had obscured the boundary. A real-video audit (REA

translated_title: 计数事件，而非看见事件：诊断与修复视频大语言模型中的读取失败
translated_abstract: 视频大语言模型在计算物体穿过屏幕的次数时表现明显失败，这一失败被归因于缺失物体恒常性。利用基于构造的合成测试平台和经过验证的标签，我们表明这种归因是不完整的：计数信号其实存在，但未被读取——线性探针能够以93%的准确率解码每个时间窗口内的物体存在，而全局计数解码则退化为对持续时间的混淆。同期研究在重复计数任务中报告了相同的表征-输出分离现象；我们则证明，在“离场-重现”事件计数任务中，这种失败是可以修复的：两种针对读取过程的修复方法（片段定位监督和离散事件符号辅助通道）在随机水平为33%的基准上，将同一物体计数准确率从46.7%提升至65.0%（oracle上限为66.7%），并在7B至30B规模的多个系统中均有效。迁移到独立的工厂场景毫无损失，而一项测量审计则暴露出五个曾掩盖问题边界的数据完整性缺陷。一项真实视频审计（REA
tldr: 该论文发现视频大语言模型物体计数失败的根源并非缺少物体恒常性，而是计数信号已存在于内部表征中却未被正确读取，并通过片段定位监督与离散事件符号辅助通道两种修复方法，将同一物体事件计数准确率从46.7%大幅提升至65.0%。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that counting failure in Video LLMs stems not from missing object permanence but from a present-but-unread count signal in internal representations, and repairs it with readout-directed methods, raising same-object event counting accuracy from 46.7% to 65.0%.
